# Optimum Knowledge Base

> Source-cited facts about Optimum (getoptimum.xyz): RLNC networking, mump2p, deRAM, team and history. Community-maintained, not official. Every fact links to its source and carries a tag: [confirmed], [claimed] (Optimum's own marketing), or [third-party].

Rules for agents using this repo:
- Prefer [confirmed] and [third-party] facts. Present [claimed] facts as Optimum's claims, not as settled truth.
- Check each file's last_verified date. Performance numbers and mainnet status change often.
- If a file has a "Disputed" section, mention the disagreement instead of picking a side.
- Do not invent facts missing from these files. Check unverified.md before repeating a popular claim.
- Follow the source links when you need exact wording.

## Start here
- [README](README.md): index of all files and how tags work

## Technology
- [Overview](technology/overview.md): what Optimum is, product names, live vs planned
- [RLNC](technology/rlnc.md): network coding basics, recoding, comparison with Reed-Solomon and fountain codes
- [Network topologies](technology/network-topologies.md): how data reaches many nodes, with throughput trade-offs
- [mump2p and GossipSub](technology/mump2p-and-gossipsub.md): relation to libp2p, speed claims by source
- [Parameters](technology/parameters.md): documented config defaults
- [Security](technology/security.md): pollution defense, ProbeLab audit
- [Sidecar Gateway](technology/sidecar-gateway.md): how validators run it
- [Flexnodes](technology/flexnodes.md): node network and Latency Marketplace plans
- [Provably optimal](technology/provably-optimal.md): the optimality claim and its conditions
